description: Converting an object without a required attribute is an error
notes: The spec's conversion rules convert an object to an object type with attributes it lacks by populating them with null (spec.md#collection-and-structural-type-conversions), which gives {a = null}, while the README says a missing object attribute would typically result in an error when type constraints are validated or used. hashicorp/hcl's typeexpr.ConvertFunc converts with go-cty's convert.Convert (ext/typeexpr/type_type.go), whose object conversion requires every attribute of the target type that isn't optional (conversionObjectToObject in cty/convert/conversion_object.go).
